seasonal_festivals.name: Spring Cleansing & The Sacred Grove
seasonal_festivals.summary: Early spring ritual honoring post-war fallen comrades, purifying lingering miasma, and liberating blighted soil.
activities: Cook 5 feast offerings at the Ancient Memorial Altar to cleanse toxic haze
Brew First-Harvest Lotus Tea for town elders
Light memorial candles for fallen Guild vanguards
rewards: Permanently unlocks the Sacred Elder Herb Grove
+100 friendship points with all town residents

seasonal_festivals.name: Adventurer Games & Firefly Night
seasonal_festivals.summary: Honoring frontier knights and miners, capped by a tranquil evening boat ride floating lanterns beneath starry fireflies.
activities: Friendly sparring exhibition match with Guildmaster Thorne
Speed-cooking tactical field rations with combat buffs
Float firefly lanterns on the midnight lake with your closest confidant
rewards: Honorary Vanguard Badge (15% discount on weapon repair at Boris's Forge)

seasonal_festivals.name: Autumn Harvest Feast & Lantern Gala
seasonal_festivals.summary: The largest annual festival celebrating abundant golden wheat harvests and mid-autumn candlelit paper lanterns.
activities: Autumn Master Chef Contest (Judges Boris, Maeve, Clara rate 3 pastries)
Hang paper lanterns and lotus candles across town avenues
Serve free pastry banquets at the Hearth Eatery tavern counter
rewards: Golden Harvest Trophy (permanently increases dish selling prices by 15%)
Traditional Heritage Recipe: Mid-Autumn Blossom Mooncake

seasonal_festivals.name: New Year Hearthfire Vigil
seasonal_festivals.summary: On the coldest New Year's Eve, the entire township gathers around Rowan's crackling hearthfire to share life stories and welcome spring.
activities: Cook a communal grand hotpot feast for the entire village
Listen to intimate New Year Eve reflections from healed residents
Pip's New Year lucky seed lottery raffle
rewards: Unlocks Grandmother Amalia's Secret Tome Volume 2
+20% growth rate for all winter greenhouse crops in the following year

recurring_events.name: Captain Garrick's Sunday Lakeshore Market
recurring_events.summary: Captain Garrick's wooden schooner docks weekly, laden with exotic ocean fish, foreign spices, and vintage Lo-fi vinyl records.

recurring_events.name: Town Maintenance & Rest Wednesday
recurring_events.summary: Boris cools forge fires for scheduled maintenance, Clara's library opens free archives, and Maeve offers 10% off seeds.
